blocks.text: Building on the success of NotAloneChallenge.org , the Inspiring Children Foundation is launching the Not Alone Summit , presented by Villa Bibbiani and powered by the Steven & Alexandra Cohen Foundation , hosted at Wynn Las Vegas. The Not Alone Summit is a premier national convening designed to bring together leading CEOs, artists, athletes, philanthropists, clinicians, researchers, and youth ambassadors to advance emotional and mental health.

Through meaningful dialogue, collaboration, storytelling, music, and a first-of-its-kind awards show, the Summit unites science, lived experience, and innovation to inspire collective action, normalize mental health conversations, and build a more compassionate and connected system of care for all.

The Not Alone Program, which includes the Challenge, Summit, and Awards Show, is produced by the Inspiring Children Foundation (ICF) — a 501(c)(3) nonprofit that has spent the last 25 years helping at-risk youth facing financial hardship, anxiety, depression, and suicidal ideation, achieving tremendous outcomes.

The Foundation’s 10 pillars of healing, growth, and high-performance living serve as a framework to help children discover and pursue their passions through sports, academics, entrepreneurship, music, art, and project-based learning. By engaging youth in these areas, ICF inspires curiosity about their physical, social, emotional, and mental health — empowering them to heal, grow, and perform at the highest level in all areas of life.

ICF’s best-in-class program operates daily from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m., 365 days a year, with a showcase program in inner-city Las Vegas, Nevada. The Not Alone Program was created to scale the Foundation’s extraordinary work and bring its proven model of transformation to a wider audience through the Challenge, Summit, and Awards Show.

blocks.text: Presenting the Not Alone Awards Show, powered by the Steven & Alexandra Cohen Foundation , broadcast live on iHeartRadio , and hosted by Wynn Resorts .

The award show was created to celebrate the pioneers of human development and mental health, the visionaries, healers, and innovators who have courageously broken barriers, challenged stigma, and illuminated the path toward healing, growth, and connection.

These awards honor those who have dedicated their lives to advancing the emotional, social, and mental well-being of humanity through research, clinical innovation, technology, advocacy, philanthropy, and art.

In a time when conversations about mental health were often dismissed or misunderstood, these extraordinary leaders chose to speak up, to care, and to act. They built bridges between science and soul, creating tools, therapies, and technologies that have transformed lives, especially for those who were once left behind, alienated, or forgotten.

Their courage has turned pain into purpose, and isolation into connection. Because of their vision, countless people have discovered that their greatest struggles can become their most profound strengths.

We are forever grateful to these champions, to the founders of the Not Alone Summit, and to all the inspiring co-sponsors who have made this celebration possible. Together, we honor those who invest in humanity and elevate the importance of the human being.
